title: Equity Research Analyst
summary: Studies listed companies and their sectors, builds earnings models and values the shares to recommend buying or selling. Works in a broking firm's research desk (sell-side) or with fund managers at a mutual fund or investment firm (buy-side), usually under a senior analyst.
dailyDuties: Update company models after quarterly results
Write earnings previews and results update notes
Value stocks using DCF and peer multiples
Join management meetings and earnings calls and take notes
Research sector trends and run channel checks
Draft sections of initiating coverage reports
Answer questions from fund managers or the sales desk

skills.expectation: Build and update company earnings models after each quarterly result
Value stocks with DCF, peer multiples or sum-of-the-parts and set target prices
Write initiating coverage reports, earnings previews and results update notes
Read annual reports and analyse ratios, cash flows and balance sheets
Track a sector and its stocks using industry data and channel checks
Prepare for and take notes in management meetings and earnings calls
Pull company and market data from Bloomberg, FactSet, Capital IQ or Indian databases
Work fast in Excel for models, comps tables and screens
Pitch stock ideas clearly to fund managers or the sales desk
Know the SEBI research analyst rules and report disclosures
Automate data pulls and screens with Python
Compare competitors' strategy and market share within the sector

certifications.why: SEBI's Research Analyst rules require NISM XV for people who write research, and posts often name it.
